name: Color Hair
overview: Scripture highlights the significance of hair and appearance within God's design and order. Deuteronomy 22:5 emphasizes the distinction God establishes between genders, warning against adopting the appearance or attire of the opposite sex. Proverbs 16:31 honors the natural aging process, describing a hoary head as a crown of glory when found in righteousness. Jesus reminds us in Matthew 5:36 that we cannot control even the color of a single hair, underscoring God's sovereign authority over our bodies, while Luke 21:18 assures believers of God's protective care down to the smallest detail, including every hair on their heads.
